All functions

Calculate the population size within length bins

Calculate a logistic selectivity curve for a length vector

Calculate a single-sided normal selectivity curve for a length vector

Calculate the selectivities for each length bin for each gear
blicc_dat()

blicc_expected_catches()
Generate expected proportional catch numbers for each gear.

Get expected BLICC selectivity, mortality, survival and length frequency

Impact from the removal of each gear on the YPR and SPR in the specified period.

Return a tibble containing a summary of the fishblicc priors being applied
